knownLimitations: Only Xmake 3.1.1 Linux x86_64 and GNU-compatible ELF linkage verified; one pinned private filename accessor remains.
Explicit Lua Job/profile env is saved configuration: pass secrets through inherited process env instead.
Advisory Linux resource locks coordinate same-user cooperating tools with the same resourceId/lock directory.
Provider cancellation is cooperative; user factories must clean up resources allocated before a rejection.
No absolute-path-independent reproducible binary claim; moving a project may intentionally change build identity.
No broad all-platform gate is passed by simulated or substituted-kernel tests.
UML Artifact route currently supports Linux x86_64 native ARCH=um only; not host/SSH or cross-architecture Driver execution.
Shared Environment means shared declarations and verified build caches, not one VM reused across Jobs.
Xmake Artifact Driver Probe DSL and Artifact Kernel Coverage are not included; legacy standalone helper features are retained.
Same-project external xmake f is not protected by the cooperating Cautest lock; pinned-context mutation fails closed, not a two-config-per-project feature.
Static ESM is automatic; hidden require/dynamic-import/data/native dependency inputs must be declared explicitly.
Only one locally compiled N-API fixture is certified here; not arbitrary serialport/USB package versions.
Legacy standalone Native/MCU helper caches are not claimed to share the new Xmake transaction lock.
MCU SPI is a behavioral software model, not pin-level or cycle-accurate hardware simulation.
